Welcome to Climb Scary Sea Life Whale Tower
❓ Can you reach the top without being eaten? (I don't think so.)

Join the group for free BAT! https://www.roblox.com/communities/668925286
🛠️ Next Update: MORE VERSIONS 😱

✨A terrifying Sea Life Whale inspired by the famous viral Cyriak whale video stalks the floors of a massive underwater tower, swimming relentlessly from level to level. As a player, you have to climb to the top while staying out of its path—each floor features a different creepy sea-life whale variant ready to chase you down and attack anyone who gets too close.

💡 Inspired by cyriak & other tower games!
